references.text: Repeats the promise that prayers offered in Jesus' name will be answered, emphasizing that this happens so that joy may be made full.
Jesus' instruction to the disciples to bear fruit and receive whatever they ask for in His name, as an expression of their close relationship with Him.
An immediate parallel in the same chapter confirming that everything asked for in Jesus' name will happen.
Jesus' prayer to the Father where He asks that the Father be glorified through the Son's actions, reflecting the purpose in John 14:13.
The Father's voice from heaven confirming that He has already glorified the Son's name and will do so again, linked to the Son's authority.
